pageid.description: ID of the member page. Only present if requested with the ids prop.

ns.description: Namespace of the member page. Only present if requested with the title prop.

title.description: Prefixed title of the member page. Only present if requested with the title prop.

sortkey.description: Sort key of the member in the category, as a hexadecimal string. Only present if requested with the sortkey prop.

sortkeyprefix.description: Human-readable part of the sort key, as given in the category link. Only present if requested with the sortkeyprefix prop.

type.description: Kind of member: a page, a subcategory or a file. Only present if requested with the type prop.

timestamp.description: Time the member was added to the category, in ISO 8601 format. Only present if requested with the timestamp prop.
